name: @projexlight/sdk-profile
summary: Tiered profile data store for ProjexCloud personas: L1 / L2 / L3 bands separate display-ish data (name, photo URL, locale) from operational data (preferences, defaults) from secure data (SSN-last-4, DOB) — each band sits in a different storage class with different access rules. Field-level cryptographic shred for GDPR Art-17 erasure on the secure band.

endpoints.description: Fetch a profile band (L1 display / L2 operational). Secure-band uses dedicated endpoint.
Replace a band's contents (audit chain pins persona + field-set diff).
Fetch secure (L3) data; requires elevated scope + writes a secure-access audit row.
Set / replace a secure field by name.
Cryptographically shred one secure field via sdk-vault key disposal.
Audit log of shred operations on a Person's secure data.

events.name: profile.band.updated.v1
events.description: Band L1 or L2 updated; carries field-set diff.

events.name: profile.secure.field.set.v1
events.description: Secure-band field set (NO plaintext in event).

events.name: profile.secure.field.read.v1
events.description: Secure-band field read; carries persona_id + caller_sdk.

events.name: profile.secure.field.shredded.v1
events.description: Secure-band field cryptographically shredded; GDPR Art-17 fulfillment trail.

models.description: L2 operational band: preferences, defaults, locale.
L3 secure band: per-(person, field) ciphertext + vault key_id.
Per-shred row: person_id, field, shred_reason, shredded_by_persona, occurred_at.

hooks.name: getBand
hooks.description: Fetch L1 or L2 band; idempotent.

hooks.name: setSecureField
hooks.description: Encrypt + store a secure field via sdk-vault.

hooks.name: getSecureField
hooks.description: Audited read of a secure field; rate-limited per persona.

hooks.name: shredSecureField
hooks.description: Cryptographically shred one field by disposing the wrapping key. Irreversible.

scenarios.title: User changes UI locale via settings page
scenarios.when_to_use: Self-serve locale change. L2 band update is cheap + non-PII; emits .band.updated.v1.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Band row updated; emits .band.updated.v1 with the field-set diff.

scenarios.title: Store SSN-last-4 as a secure-band field
scenarios.when_to_use: Financial-services onboarding requires SSN-last-4. setSecureField wraps the value with sdk-vault + the plaintext never leaves the call.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Ciphertext stored; emits .secure.field.set.v1 (no plaintext). Subsequent reads audited.

scenarios.title: Compliance officer reads SSN-last-4 for an OFAC check
scenarios.when_to_use: Officer with elevated scope reads the field; we log who read what, when, why.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Plaintext returned. Emits .secure.field.read.v1 with persona + reason. Rate-limit blocks anomalous bursts.

scenarios.title: GDPR erasure → cryptographic shred of secure fields
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on data-rights.request.opened.v1 — shred every secure field for the subject by disposing the wrapping keys.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Each field's wrapping key disposed; ciphertext becomes permanently unreadable. Shred log retains the audit trail.

scenarios.title: Anomalous secure-read burst → throttle + alert
scenarios.when_to_use: A persona suddenly reads 100 SSN-last-4 in an hour — the rate-limit fails subsequent reads + posts an alert.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Reads throttled. Security alerted. SOC2 anomaly-detection control satisfied.

compliance_posture.notes: Three-band separation matches the data-classification regimes — L1 display data can sit in Redis caches, L2 operational data in app DB, L3 secure data only in vault-wrapped storage. Field-level shred is the GDPR Art-17 + HIPAA right-to-be-forgotten implementation.
